# PLOS Your Say

> > A community blog platform for researchers, public health advocates, and science communicators to share insights on global health, science communication, and research practices.

PLOS Your Say features perspectives from researchers worldwide on topics spanning women's health, digital health innovation, infectious diseases, and the practice of science communication. The blog amplifies voices from regions including India, Africa, and beyond, addressing challenges in healthcare access, research methodology, and effective science outreach.

## Key Topics

- Global health equity
- Women's health and menopause
- Science communication strategies
- Digital health and AI in healthcare
- COVID-19 and infectious diseases
- India and Africa health systems
- Social media for researchers
- Mental health and wellbeing
- Academic writing and career development
- Public health policy
- Vaccine access and barriers
- Universal Health Coverage (UHC)
- Antimicrobial resistance
- Science journalism practices

## Global Health & Healthcare Innovation

- [World Pneumonia Day: Climate change, migration, and misinformation are combining to hinder global access to a life-saving vaccine against child pneumonia](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/11/world-pneumonia-day-climate-change-migration-and-misinformation-are-combining-to-hinder-global-access-to-a-life-saving-vaccine-against-child-pneumonia): Johns Hopkins analysis of barriers to child pneumonia vaccination access
- [The Potential of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare: Transforming Patient Care and Administrative Efficiency](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/the-potential-of-artificial-intelligence-in-healthcare-transforming-patient-care-and-administrative-efficiency): AI applications in healthcare for patient care and admin efficiency
- [The Future of Women's Health: How AI and Smart Financing are Closing the Gaps](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/the-future-of-womens-health-how-ai-and-smart-financing-are-closing-the-gaps): AI and innovative financing solutions for women's health disparities
- [Revolutionizing Healthcare: The Digital Drive towards Universal Health Coverage in India](https://yoursay.plos.org/2023/10/revolutionizing-healthcare-the-digital-drive-towards-universal-health-coverage-in-india): Digital health technology enabling Universal Health Coverage in India
- [Ending a Global Epidemic: Tuberculosis in Children #UnitetoEndTB](https://yoursay.plos.org/2016/03/ending-a-global-epidemic-tuberculosis-in-children-unitetoendtb): Childhood tuberculosis diagnosis and treatment challenges in Africa
- [#WorldMalariaDay: can nets and sprays keep the bugs away?](https://yoursay.plos.org/2017/04/worldmalariaday-can-nets-and-sprays-keep-the-bugs-away): World Malaria Day analysis of mosquito net and spray effectiveness

## Women's Health Research

- [The impact of Natural and Surgical Menopause in the Indian Population](https://yoursay.plos.org/2023/12/the-impact-of-natural-and-surgical-menopause-in-the-indian-population): Research on menopause health outcomes in Indian women by Pati et al.
- [Menopause: Neglected, Under Researched but IMPORTANT](https://yoursay.plos.org/2023/10/menopause-neglected-under-researched-but-important): Advocacy for increased menopause research and awareness globally
- [You are special: The importance of identifying patients and their accompanying needs with metastatic breast cancer worldwide](https://yoursay.plos.org/2023/06/you-are-special-the-importance-of-identifying-patients-and-their-accompanying-needs-with-metastatic-breast-cancer-worldwide): Global disparities in metastatic breast cancer care needs worldwide

## Science Communication & Public Engagement

- [Social media tips for researchers](https://yoursay.plos.org/2023/03/social-media-tips-for-researchers): Guide on using social media for academic outreach and citation boost
- [OK to GO: Rehabilitating Awesome](https://yoursay.plos.org/2010/11/ok-to-go-rehabilitating-awesome): Science communication piece on restoring wonder in science journalism
- [Language Matters: Is it Social or Physical Distancing to be followed during the COVID-19 Pandemic?](https://yoursay.plos.org/2020/05/language-matters-is-it-social-or-physical-distancing-to-be-followed-during-the-covid-19-pandemic): COVID-19 terminology debate on physical vs social distancing impact

## Academic Career & Research Practice

- [Ten Lessons About Writing Journal Papers Your Mother Never Taught You](https://yoursay.plos.org/2021/10/ten-lessons-about-writing-journal-papers-your-mother-never-taught-you): Academic writing guide to avoid desk rejection and improve manuscripts
- [How creating purpose through non-research activities can help your scientific career](https://yoursay.plos.org/2022/04/how-creating-purpose-through-non-research-activities-can-help-your-scientific-career): Career advice on balancing research with creative hobbies and outreach
- [Remote PhD Defense: Lessons Learned](https://yoursay.plos.org/2020/06/remote-phd-defense-lessons-learned): University of Toronto student's virtual PhD defense tips and insights

## Mental Health & Wellbeing

- [Disconnect to Reconnect: Adolescents Embracing Digital Detox](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/05/disconnect-to-reconnect-adolescents-embracing-digital-detox): Digital detox strategies for adolescent mental health and wellbeing
- [NeuroTribes, Steve Silberman on a haunting history and new hope for autistic people](https://yoursay.plos.org/2015/11/neurotribes-steve-silberman-on-a-haunting-history-and-new-hope-for-autistic-people): Interview with Steve Silberman on autism history and neurodiversity

## Optional

- [Can Insects Counter the Menace of Superbugs](https://yoursay.plos.org/2023/09/can-insects-counter-the-menace-of-superbugs): Insect-derived antimicrobial compounds as antibiotic resistance solution
- [Spicing up health: A study on cinnamon-infused yoghurt in Africa](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/05/spicing-up-health-a-study-on-cinnamon-infused-yoghurt-in-africa): African food innovation research on cinnamon yoghurt health benefits
- [The U.S. Needs a Lesson in Food Policy from Mexico by Daniel Taber, PhD, MPH](https://yoursay.plos.org/2016/01/the-u-s-needs-a-lesson-in-food-policy-from-mexico-by-daniel-taber-phd-mph): Mexico's soda tax success as model for US obesity prevention policy
